senses.gloss: a mnemotechnical formula, for <he>לא תֹאכלו</he> (<cite ref="Leviticus 11:11">Lev. XI, 11</cite>), <he>אֹל תשקצו</he> (ib. 43), <he>וֹלא תטמאו</he> (<cite ref="Leviticus 11:11">ib.</cite>), and <he>אין לו סֹנפיר וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 14:10">Deut. XIV, 10</cite>).
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 24a">Pes. 24ᵃ</cite> bot. Ar. (missing in ed. a. Mss.).
